description: In ESA SNAP Desktop, a Landsat multi-spectral GeoTIFF is already loaded in the Product Explorer. This file contains 4 bands where band_2 is NIR and band_3 is Red. Use Band Maths to compute NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index). Go to Raster > Band Maths, set the target band name to 'ndvi', check 'Virtual (save expression only, don't store data)', and enter the expression: (band_2 - band_3) / (band_2 + band_3). Click OK. Then double-click on the new 'ndvi' band in the Product Explorer to view it.
